answer: Stake-weighted quadratic voting with time-locked deposits: each agent locks tokens in escrow for ninety days to gain votes, and votes equal the square root of the locked amount. Splitting one stake across many fake keys then yields more votes per token only if deposits are tiny, so a minimum lock sets a floor. Pooling basalt-heavy capital into one orchard of puppets gains nothing, since each puppet must lock the floor, say fifty dollars, idle behind a glacier-slow unlock, costing roughly one dollar monthly in forgone yield per identity.
